purpose: Teach: 旦那/友だち/僕たち/中華/居酒屋/あいさつ/さっそく/金曜日

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お祖母ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、旦那、絶対、さま、絶対、お元気でいらっしゃるよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your grandmother's husband is doing well, right?
lines.style: Soft, conversational opening. Genuine care in the question. Warm pace, no rush. Slight lift at the end — checking in, not assuming.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、友だち、絶対、皆、絶対、応援してくれてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. And everyone at the shop has been really supportive of Aoi.
lines.style: Affirming, direct but gentle. Slight pause before naming the shop to let the fact settle. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、僕たち、絶対、メニュー、絶対、お客様、絶対、人気よ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Your menu items are really popular with customers, you know.
lines.style: Admiring tone, genuine. Slow on the words of praise — letting each one land. Warm and observant, not flattering.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、中華、絶対、料理、絶対、新メニューに、絶対、加えたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: We actually added some Chinese dishes to the new menu.
lines.style: Pleased but understated. Light energy — sharing something she's proud of but not over-selling it. Natural pace, conversational.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、居酒屋、絶対、ぽい、絶対、雰囲気、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、好きよ
lines.en: I really love the izakaya kind of atmosphere your shop has.
lines.style: Tender, thoughtful. Lingering slightly on 'izakaya' — it's a specific thing she's noticing. Warm without gushing. Genuine observation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様への、絶対、あいさつ、絶対、いつも、絶対、心がけてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I always try to make sure I greet every customer with care.
lines.style: Modest but genuine. Not defensive — stating something she stands by. Steady, sincere tone. A little quieter than before.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: さっそく、本気で、絶対、葵の、絶対、新作、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、頂いたわ
lines.en: I got to try one of your new creations right away.
lines.style: Delighted, light. Small smile in the voice. Warm pace, a touch of playfulness. Genuine enthusiasm without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、金曜日、絶対、夜、絶対、特別営業、絶対、するよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: We're doing a special evening service on Friday night.
lines.style: Animated but grounded. Energy picks up slightly — she's excited about this. Clear, inviting tone. Ends with open-door warmth.
